data.name: Tank Brawl
data.detailed_description:
Características

  • Shared screen 2 players cooperative
  • 5 different tank upgrades
  • Level Editor & Custom Maps
  • Destructible environment
  • 23 levels long campaign
  • 7 power-ups
  • Survival mode with leader board
  • 5 themes including Lush Jungle and Ocean Highway.
  • Simple controls ( supports 2 controllers )


Acerca do jogo


The perfect game to play local co-op with your friends and partners with classic top-down game play and simple yet dynamic controls. It come with eye-candy 3D graphic modernization of the classic Battle City with tons of added features to give it more depth and visual appeal.With Level Editor & Custom Maps option, game play is designed to entertain casual gamers and challenge hardcore serious gamers at the same time!


    The camera view were carefully designed to offer the best local co-op experience possible. Two players will share the same screen ( i.e no split screen ) with intelligently positioned camera so that both players will have the best possible view all the time.


    Hills and crate boxes are all destructible, so you have to decide if you will destroy them to clear a firing path or keep them there as your hiding place.


    We design a simple to understand yet quite tactical customization system. After each level, you are rewarded a certain number of points for upgrading your tank. You can spend points to upgrade the tank’s damage power, movement speed, bullet speed, life count or the point earning rate which effect how many points you earn after each battle. The last two upgrades requires you to think tactically to decide whether to invest in point earning rate so his tank very powerful later in the game or spending points now to get pass current levels.


    There are many interesting power-ups hidden under boxes, enemy tanks or just laying on the ground. These include Pet Tanks, Picked-up Bombs, Size Increase, Slow Motion Time, Immortal Shield, Base Shield.


There are 23 levels, and these divided into 6 themes areas each with its own feeling and mood:
  • High attitude mountain
  • Desert
  • Underground crystal mining
  • Sea high way
  • Lush jungle
  • Enemy industrial City

There are 2 types of level: small ones fit entire in your viewing screen, so that camera is fixed and doesn’t move, this resembles the classic Battle City game play. There are also larger levels in which game camera following your tank as he moves, this resembles more of an adventure shooting type of game play. These 2 types of levels are intersecting each other so you don't get bored of one type.
As you progress through levels they are gradually introduced to more powerful enemies and more power-ups.


    Flexible Level Editor & Upload your custom map to play and challenge community to conquer your map !


    Control is very simple to immediately hook you into actions without going through boring tutorials. Controls just include four directional buttons (up, down, left, right) and a single fire button. Your tank movement is restricted to horizontal and vertical and no diagonal movement is allowed. This allows easy and precise control of the tank which is mandatory for fast pace, fun game-play.


    Along the main campaign we also have a survival mode where you compete to beat the record scores of surviving endless waves of enemies.


    A great emphasis is placed on making great visual as we want this to be a HD experience of the classic game play. We concentrated our best effort on the firing and enemy tank explosion animations as we think these are the two most satisfying actions that the you experiences. When firing, tank’s gun recoils, air shock wave and nozzle fire created. Enemies recoil and exploding when hit. After exploding, tank burning bodies remains. Also the tank movement is also treated well with tank acceleration and braking animation. When moving, tank body goes up and down relative to its treads, this make it looks realistic as tanks move through bumpy terrains.Tanks leave dust, smoke and tread mark on ground behind.

For more info, please visit :

reviews.review:
Tank brawl is a top down tank shooter. It’s a fun shooter with plenty to offer. It’s ‘inspired’ from NES classic “Battle city”, even though it’s different it still has elements from that game. It has some RPG elements too in which you can upgrade certain things in your tank. These upgrades really do matter and can be used strategically to win a certain level you’re unable to beat. Power-ups, hard levels and bosses will keep you coming back for more and more. Game can also be played in co-op mode locally

[b][u] Graphics: [/u][/b]

The game looks gorgeous and colorful. Different stages have different themes like Jungle, Sahara etc. The game is based on Unreal engine. There’s not many graphic options to configure, only ones available are post processing (includes anti-aliasing and depth of field toggles), resolution and fog. Considering this is a top down shooter that’s not really a problem. 

[b][u] Sound: [/u][/b]

The sound is average in this game, the soundtrack wasn’t too amazing but it was not boring by any means as well. The sounds for explosions and hitting enemy are spot on. Overall not too bad sound though lack of sound adjustment sliders is not good. You only have the option to turn the music on or off, there is no slider to adjust volume which can be a pain as I had to alt-tab out and lower volume from windows.

[b][u] Gameplay: [/u][/b]

There are 23 total levels In the game and they get harder as the game progresses. Later levels can be really challenging but not too hard as to discourage players. Each level you beat earns you a point which you can use to improve your tank. There’s 5 upgrades in total which are tank speed, damage, bullet speed, life and point rewards. The life and point rewards become useful when you hit a certain number of upgrades invested into them e.g the life upgrade will give you an extra life when you have 5 points invested into this tree. Same with Rewards if you invest 5 points you’ll gain 2 points instead of 1. The other upgrades however can be incremental in each point. Though they still have perks or reaching a certain number of points in the damage, speed and fast bullet upgrades. If you upgrade speed with 10 points you gain a frontal crusher. If you upgrade damage with 7 points you will gain explosive ammo and if you upgrade fast bullets with 7 points you will gain a rechargeable beam-like power shot.

You can customize this upgrade tree at anytime and this is where the strategy part comes in. Being able to adjust your tank for each level you can easily customize your tank according to that specific level. Boss too fast? Just upgrade your tank speed for that level, Boss is a bullet sponge? Simply upgrade damage or bullet speed. These upgrades come very handy for later tougher level.

Each level requires you to kill off all enemy tanks and in some levels you have a base which you must protect. If the enemy destroys your little base you’ll have to restart the level. In my opinion those levels can get annoying as later game can become a bullet hell with lots of tanks shooting at you. You have to protect yourself and your base which can sometimes cause frustration. The levels also have destructible environments, these blocks can be destroyed and a path can be made, enemy fire also breaks these blocks. There’s also a death meter which tells you how many times you have died.

There’s many types of enemy tanks, your good’ol pawn tank which can be killed with one bullet, the stronger armored tanks, the speedy tanks and faster bullet tanks, super fast tanks with spikes etc. As the levels progress these tanks also get stronger and require more damage to be killed. The bosses are also interesting and require you to be patient and make a strategy to kill them.

There are in-game power-ups and weapons. One such power-up is bombs which can be picked up and thrown and can be exploded on demand. Although when you have placed a bomb you cannot shoot as the bomb explode button is the same as your shoot button so when you press the shoot button the bomb will explode and then you can shoot normally. Another power-up is these tiny friendly tanks which can tag along you once you run over them. They follow your tank and shoot randomly in any direction they want. Sometimes they can also get you killed as they open up these destructible blocks where you intended it not to be opened. There are also pick-ups, one of these pick-ups is the bullet time effect where time slows down for the enemies but you carry on your usual speed. Another one is the shield. These run out within a few seconds.


[b][u] Graphics: 8/10 [/u][/b]
[b][u] Sound: 6/10 [/u][/b]
[b][u] Gameplay: 9/10 [/u][/b]
[b][u] Overall: 8/10 [/u][/b]


[b][u] Conclusion: [/u][/b]

Very fun arcade-type tank shooter. It has some RPG elements and overall a very fun experience. Fans of Battle City on NES should like this, it’s sort of a different approach to the genre but very fun nonetheless.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows XP SP3
  • Processador: 2.0+ GHz processor
  • Memória: 2 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: A graphics card with shader model 3.0 support and 512 MB Memory
  • DirectX: Versão 9.0
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 1 GB de espaço livre
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processador: 2.0+ GHz multi-core processor
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA 8000 series or higher graphics card
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 1 GB de espaço livre
